entities.summary: Major General Juan Rius Rivera, was a soldier and revolutionary leader from Puerto Rico who served in the Cuban Liberation Army and reached the highest military rank in the army. He held Cuban ministerial offices after independence and In his later years he also became a successful businessperson in Honduras.
